edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: Open is the everyday opposite of closed, so 'rather than open' tells the reader nothing new and can be cut.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose.
edits.reason: 'By accident' is the everyday opposite of 'on purpose', so the trailing clause adds nothing and can be cut.
